text:
Renee Morales: Quick announce — previewing 'onprem-crypto-authz' for Private installs. This adds fine-grained crypto operation authorization and per-action attestation logs for customers who need proof of key usage.
Renee Morales: Motivation: some regulated customers require a tamper-evident ledger of which principals requested cryptographic operations (sign/decrypt/wrap). This feature lets us emit signed attestations bound to a tenant's KMS policy.
Jasper Klein: How it works: control plane emits an attestation object for each crypto operation. Attestation contains operation metadata, caller identity, KMS key id, nonce, and an RFC-compliant signature. Attestations are append-only and exportable.
Renee Morales: Supported flows at preview: sign, verify, wrap-key, unwrap-key. Not yet supporting bulk-encrypt in this preview.
Renee Morales: Activation: customer toggles 'crypto_authz: enabled' in private-config.yaml and provides an attestation signing key (can be Redwood-managed or customer-supplied HSM).
Security: If customers choose Redwood-managed signing, we rotate attestation keys every 90 days and publish rotation statements. If customer supplies an HSM, we support offline key attestation exchange for air-gapped sites.
Product Ops: Required contract change: add 'Crypto Attestation Addendum' for Redwood-managed signing. Customers using their own HSM do not need the addendum.
Jasper Klein: CLI example to pull attestations for tenant t-77 between two timestamps:
```
redwoodctl private attestations fetch --tenant t-77 --from 2026-04-01T00:00Z --to 2026-04-02T00:00Z > attestations.json
jq .attestations | less
```
Security: Emergency access note: attestation export is gated by tenant policy; requests for raw key material never pass through this path. Any emergency unseal/unwrap requires documented dual-approver flow.
Renee Morales: Rollout plan: canary tomorrow in pk-staging-9, limited preview to invited customers in 2 weeks, GA after compliance sign-off and HSM integration tests.
Oncall Bot: DeployBot: canary rollout started pk-staging-9 at 2026-03-25T11:02:00Z — job db-8122.
Jasper Klein: SRE ask: add a liveliness check that verifies attestation signature validity as part of the health probe. We'll share a small validation tool for the probe.
Renee Morales: Docs + runbook incoming. If you want to be part of preview testing or need a demo, ping @Product Ops. Please label bugs private-crypto-authz-preview.
Product Ops: Preview invites + addendum links scheduled to send 2026-03-26 09:00 PT.
